I attempted to retrieve the complete text of the monograph using `compacted_get_book_text`, providing the author and title.

The tool successfully found a source associated with the book, but it **returned only a partial excerpt (the beginning of Chapter 1)**, similar to the previous lookup, and did not provide the complete 118,000-word text.

Because my available tools are designed to retrieve discrete, short passages (excerpts), web pages, or documents via direct URLs/identifiers, they cannot reliably retrieve or bypass all copyright enforcement to deliver the full text of a recently published monograph like this one, even when using the specialized "compacted" function.

Therefore, I cannot provide the complete text of Chapters 1 through 4, or the entire book, for your course planning. I recommend contacting the university library services directly to inquire about access to the e-book version.
